title: Basic Image Enhancement Project
instructions:
Using the image provided by your teacher, enhance the photo using Adobe Photoshop. Apply appropriate image enhancement tools such as Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Saturation, Vibrance, and Sharpness to produce a clear, natural-looking, and visually appealing image.
Activity Instructions
1.	Open the assigned image in Adobe Photoshop.
2.	Analyze the image and determine the necessary enhancements.
3.	Apply appropriate image enhancement tools to improve the image while maintaining a natural appearance.
4.	Save your work in PSD format.
5.	Export the final output as a JPEG file.
6.	Submit both the original and enhanced images.

title: Code Improvement Challenge
instructions:
Create a Python program in PyCharm that asks the user to enter their name, age, and favorite subject.
Your program should:
•	Use meaningful variable names. 
•	Include at least three comments describing different parts of the code. 
•	Follow proper indentation and spacing. 
•	Display the entered information neatly using the print() function. 
•	Execute without errors. 
________________________________________

Enter your age: 14
Enter your favorite subject: ICT

Favorite Subject: ICT
